title: Sussur Dagger
summary: +1 weapon can silence foes on melee hits.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, One-handed, 5 ft melee, Finesse, Light, Thrown, Dippable. 1d4 + 1 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity. +1 to attack rolls.
fields.Silencing: Melee hit forces DC 12 Constitution save. Failure Silences for 2 turns, preventing speech and verbal spellcasting while granting Thunder immunity. Thrown hits never apply it.
fields.Crafting: Combine a normal Dagger and Sussur Tree Bark at the Blacksmith’s Forge. Some nonstandard variants cannot be used.
fields.Piercing Strike: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon damage. CON save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Successful hits gain 2 Piercing. Honour Mode adds 2 of the original type to any damage source. Healing clears it. Undead and Constructs are immune.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
